Interested in hosted_api for fast time-to-value; plan is self-serve PoC. Key ask: clarify procurement — credit card vs invoice, startup discount eligibility, ability to extend free credits if PoC runs long.

Timeline / recent activity:

Use-case details / requirements (customer language fragments):
- "Need fast low-effort integration — we want embed + chat in product within 2 weeks."

- Throughput: 20-80 reqs/min during peak; low token volume initially.
- Cost sensitivity: high — startup with limited runway, wants predictable monthly cap.
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated smaller models; prioritize cost over latest SOTA.
- Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when tokens spike.
- Security: SSO for admin console, basic audit logs; no on-prem requirement.

Procurement notes / negotiation points:
- Customer prefers credit card for initial months; finance may request invoice once reach threshold (~$2k/mo).
- Requesting confirmation on startup discount (equity or YC-like discount?) and possibility to extend free credits by 30 days if PoC extends.
- Next finance deliverable: send official pricing deck + short terms sheet showing CC vs invoice flow, and note of startup discount eligibility.

Open action items (short):
- AE (Maya): send pricing deck + confirm credit extension decision by 2026-03-12.
- SE (Daniel): provide recommended batching/kv-cache config for doc-search sample (due 2026-03-14).

Notes tone: choppy, CRM shorthand. Customer seems likely to convert to paid in 1-3 months if billing path sorted and credits extended.
